correctness.rationale: For all n≥3 and permutations phi, spoke s_i conflicts only with o_i sharing tail and t_i sharing head after reindexing inner rim; the ONLY directed cycles in an admissible partial injection are the full coherent outer and inner rims. Local join has five faces per index; excluding the two full rims yields 5^n−2^(n+1)+1 augmented faces. Decompose X=L∪W where L=∂Δ(O)*∂Δ(T)=S^(2n−3), W=union of closed spoke stars, with every nonempty intersection contractible and nerve a full simplex, hence W contractible. Overlap B=L∩W covered by n simplices with nerve ∂Δ^(n−1)=S^(n−2). Cofibration pushout and nullhomotopic B→L (dimension n−2<2n−3) give wedge S^(n−1)∨S^(2n−3). Reindex t_i makes phi immaterial. Independent 5-letter local enumeration returned 110,594,3062,15498 faces for n=3,4,5,6 as formula predicts; source direct directed graph-vs-local checker covers small cases. Infinite result relies on exact topological cover, not enumeration.
